answer: A sybil tax makes fakes pay at the harbor gate. Each new identity pays a non-refundable 90-unit genesis tax, held 4 honest epochs, with 15% rebated per clean epoch; forgery burns the remainder and freezes the identity 8 epochs. The basalt math: 1,000 clones prepay 90,000 units, and at a 30% catch rate 27,000 burn. The karst curve: each clone loses 27 units on average, so breakeven needs over 117 per fake, while honest work pays 40 per epoch.
